text: A text offer lets the family grab a time with one tap, without phone tag. But the time isn't theirs until they confirm.
From the waitlist, the Book window has a Text offer button.
The one thing to remember: a text offer doesn't hold the slot. Check Texted offers before you send another.
Scout writes the message, and adds the link for you.
Read Check before sending before you send.
Every offer is listed in Texted offers, with its status.
This is what Maria sees when she taps the link.
The visit is booked straight away.
Back in Texted offers, Maria's confirmed offer is in To review. Check it on the calendar. Once it's reviewed, it moves to Booked.

The most common mistakes: telling the family the time is booked before they confirm, and sending a second offer while the first is still pending. Remember: a text offer doesn't hold the slot. Check Texted offers before you send another.
